name: Rasen Falcon
subtitle: The public home of Alchemy
strapline: Software, systems, and the art of intention.

identity.concept: An original abstract wattle sprig, institutional restraint, cream paper, charcoal ink, muted wattle gold. No Commonwealth insignia or government claim.
identity.tone: Calm, precise, unusually modest for a technical organisation; language supports verifiable capabilities and the distinction between research and deployed service.

footer: An independent home for the Alchemy project. Descriptions are of ongoing engineering work; no availability or fitness-for-purpose commitment is implied.
